owner_taste_model.CONTROLLED_TEMPORAL_HIERARCHY: supporting inference only from existing restraint and hierarchy laws; not an OWNER lock and not a fixed timing ratio
owner_taste_model.SPARSE_ACCENT_HIERARCHY: CONFIRMED_SUPPORTING_SIGNAL only: existing OWNER law explicitly prefers sparse accents after macro silhouette/value structure; this cycle supports relational chroma hierarchy as a QC aid but does not create a universal one-accent or numeric chroma-threshold law.
owner_taste_model.STRUCTURAL_NEGATIVE_SPACE: CONFIRMED_SUPPORTING_SIGNAL: existing OWNER laws favor macro readability and structural identity; meaningful negative space should be protected when it carries those structures, but this cycle does not elevate a new OWNER lock.
owner_taste_model.VALUE_MASS_ECONOMY: CONFIRMED_SUPPORTING_SIGNAL only: existing OWNER laws support controlled palette/value bands and macro-over-micro readability; this is not a universal K=3 law and does not override the 4-6 production tone-band envelope.

self_model.ACCENT_COMPETITION_RULE: A second high-chroma mass can destroy focal uniqueness even when both colors are individually attractive; measure top-vs-second chroma competition before adding more accents.
self_model.CHROMA_HIERARCHY_RULE: Judge color emphasis relationally: a focal accent is useful when it remains distinctly stronger than supporting chroma, not merely because its saturation is numerically high.
self_model.CLEANUP_CONFIDENCE_RULE: Do not generalize a cleanup scale from one image; require changed/unseen transfer and reject methods that preserve silhouette while materially collapsing interior negative-space structure.
self_model.COLOR_CONFIDENCE_RULE: Synthetic Lab separation is a diagnostic for hierarchy behavior, not a production taste threshold; require approved real-raster transfer before promoting the skill beyond PARTIAL.
self_model.DETAIL_FRAGMENTATION_RULE: When coarse anime readability is the objective, extra value clusters are suspect until they prove structural benefit rather than merely fitting local shading or noise.
self_model.MEASURE_EMPTY_SPACE_AS_STRUCTURE: When black/white readability matters, evaluate meaningful negative spaces as explicit connected shapes with count, area and position instead of judging only outer contour or foreground detail.
self_model.SYNTHETIC_CONFIDENCE_RULE: Perfect synthetic separation proves method behavior only; it does not prove production generalization.
self_model.TIMING_CONFIDENCE_RULE: do not promote a synthetic frame-spacing ratio into a universal perceptual threshold without real character-motion transfer
self_model.TIMING_RELATION_RULE: judge impact by spacing relationships and holds before adding drawings or effects
self_model.TIMING_SCALE_RULE: normalize motion before comparing different travel distances or shot scales
self_model.VALUE_MASS_CAPACITY_RULE: Choose the smallest palette capacity that preserves intended semantic value masses; fewer bands are not automatically cleaner when they collapse a required mass.
